what: trụ lan can đường đi bộ Hạ Long: the panel of red brown granite in the parapet of the walk of Hạ Long, a piece of 0.75 m of the parapet with a body of red brown granite under the grey top slab
uses: Plan 0026: in the row of lan_can_ha_long, between two pieces of 2 m about every 10 m (the interval is from photo 1 of 2021: Check). It has the section and the ports of lan_can_ha_long, so the row goes on with no gap.

sources.author: Kwozyn
sources.shows: Two men sit on the parapet of the walk of the sea of Hạ Long at sunset, to the north-west: the parapet clad in smooth grey granite with a top slab and a panel of red brown granite, a dark band at its foot, the walk of light tiles with dark square tiles, the boats of the bay, Núi Lớn.

sources.author: Trường Hà / VnExpress
sources.shows: Hạ Long empty in the lockdown, a curve of the road: the parapet of the walk on the sea side, light stone with narrow red brown bands (panels seen at a slant) and dark red blocks a little higher than the parapet about every 10 m, small stone seats, lamp posts of white globes, the road with a double yellow line.

length.source: Photo 0: the panel of red brown granite is 143 px to 150 px wide where the parapet is 173 px high (0.9 m): 0.75 m.

height.source: Photo 0: the panel goes from the dark band at the foot up to the top slab, which goes on over it: the height of the parapet, 0.9 m.

width.source: Photo 0: the face of the panel is flush with the grey cladding: the body of the parapet, 0.4 m.

colors.source: Photo 0: dark red brown granite (#281213 in the shade of the evening); photo 1 (2021): dark red (#563932 on the side of a pillar in the shade). The face on the side of the sea is red brown too: estimate (no source).

looks.seen: Next to photos 0 and 1: the block of 0.75 m under the grey top slab and the dark band at the foot are as the panel in photo 0. The red brown is too light and too orange: in photo 0 the panel is a dark red brown, and in photo 1 the pillars are dark red.

Next to photos 0 and 1: the panel is now a dark red brown under the light grey top slab, as in photo 0; its face is flush with the parapet, so the row goes on with no step. In photo 1 (2021) some red blocks stand 0.15 m over the parapet: this piece does not have that.
The mid level of the last blueprint: the same as the look before.

Next to photo 0: the edges of the top slab are sharp, the red brown face is even; the near level of a blueprint that I changed after it (the near levels of the other pieces with an image of 1024 texels stopped on the factory), so I built it once more.
looks.changed: The images of the near level of all pieces to 512 texels, the joints of the other pieces wider (they are not on this piece).

looks.seen: The mid level of the last blueprint: the same as the look before.
The near level of the last blueprint: as the near level before; next to photo 0 the dark red brown panel under the grey top slab with sharp edges, the dark band at the foot.

Report 0026, Q25: the files of the lock of World e8754d6 (build/look/tru_lan_can_ha_long_far.png). One red brown block with a lighter top.
